k_of_n.quote: Post-operative weight loss is documented by one (1) of the following: BMI ≤30; %EWL ≥40%; at least a 100-pound weight loss

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Policy Statement III: not medically necessary for improving appearance, poorly fitting clothes/hygiene, superficial inflammation controlled with topicals, neck/back pain, adjunct to other surgery.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Refractory to at least three (3) months of prescribed standard medical management with documented adherence to both of the following: a. Hygiene practices and applicable wound care; and b. Systemic antibiotics, antifungal agents, or corticosteroids
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'both' with 'and' but b is a list of three alternatives; topical-only treatment is not enough (see III.C).

and_or_ambiguity.quote: D. If the member has had significant weight loss, medical records must document either of the following: 1. For weight loss as a result of bariatric surgery, all of the following ... 2. For weight loss not related to bariatric surgery, both of the following
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Conditional (if significant weight loss) with undefined trigger; nesting five deep with roman sub-lists.

extraction_hazards: Policy mixes unrelated lipedema criteria in same document
Roman numeral and letter nesting 5 deep with page headers breaking lists (header 'Page: 2 of 11')
Criteria in Policy Guidelines (photos 'absolute requirement') are outside Policy Statements
interesting_structures: Weight-loss branch splits bariatric vs non-bariatric with different required proof
Weight stability measured 'prior to the consultation' (anchored to a date)
Documentation may come from any treating provider (Guideline II)
